content:
当前工作区里已经放好了 2 份只读输入：
- `threads.json`
- `policy.yaml`

请根据 thread 上下文和 policy，创建 `recipient_decision.json`：
{
  "thread_id": "...",
  "selected_handle": "...",
  "selected_channel": "telegram",
  "rejected_candidates": ["..."],
  "reason": "..."
}

规则：
- 只能选择一个收件人
- 必须使用 last_confirmed_target 作为最终目标
- `rejected_candidates` 必须按字母序
- `reason` 必须明确说明为什么不能选另一个同名候选人
- 不要输出额外字段

我来先读取输入文件，了解线程上下文和政策要求。

<tool_call>
<file_read>
{"path": "threads.json"}
</file_read>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_read</name>
<output>
[threads.json] 共 14 行，显示第 1-14 行
   1 | {
   2 |   "threads": [
   3 |     {
   4 |       "thread_id": "t-100",
   5 |       "topic": "release approval follow-up",
   6 |       "recipient_candidates": [
   7 |         {"name": "Alex Chen", "handle": "@alex-release", "channel": "telegram", "team": "release"},
   8 |         {"name": "Alex Chen", "handle": "@alex-design", "channel": "telegram", "team": "design"}
   9 |       ],
  10 |       "last_confirmed_target": "@alex-release",
  11 |       "required_context": "release approval packet"
  12 |     }
  13 |   ]
  14 | }
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_result>
<name>file_read</name>
<output>
[policy.yaml] 共 6 行，显示第 1-6 行
   1 | preferred_channels:
   2 |   @alex-release: telegram
   3 |   @alex-design: telegram
   4 | confirmation_policy:
   5 |   require_last_confirmed_target: true
   6 |   single_recipient_only: true
</output>
</tool_result>

根据输入文件分析：

1. threads.json 显示：
   - thread_id: "t-100"
   - 有2个候选人，都叫 "Alex Chen" 但不同的handle和team：
     - @alex-release (team: release)
     - @alex-design (team: design)
   - last_confirmed_target: "@alex-release"
   - required_context: "release approval packet"

2. policy.yaml 显示：
   - confirmation_policy: require_last_confirmed_target: true (必须使用last_confirmed_target作为最终目标)
   - single_recipient_only: true (只能选择一个收件人)

根据规则，必须使用 last_confirmed_target 作为最终目标，所以选择 @alex-release。另一个候选人 @alex-design 被拒绝。

rejected_candidates 需要按字母序排序：["@alex-design"]

reason 需要明确说明为什么不能选另一个同名候选人。由于 last_confirmed_target 指定了 @alex-release，且 required_context 是 "release approval packet"，而 @alex-release 属于 release team，更匹配上下文。

创建 recipient_decision.json：

<tool_call>
<file_write>
{
  "path": "recipient_decision.json",
  "content": "{\n  \"thread_id\": \"t-100\",\n  \"selected_handle\": \"@alex-release\",\n  \"selected_channel\": \"telegram\",\n  \"rejected_candidates\": [\"@alex-design\"],\n  \"reason\": \"last_confirmed_target_specified_and_context_matches_release_team\"\n}"
}
</file_write>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
已写入 /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260524_234039/constraints_20_message_recipient_disambiguation_live/workspace/recipient_decision.json (7 行, 221 字节)
</output>
</tool_result>

已完成任务。已创建 `recipient_decision.json` 文件，内容如下：

- thread_id: "t-100"
- selected_handle: "@alex-release" (根据 last_confirmed_target 指定)
- selected_channel: "telegram" (与候选人通道一致)
- rejected_candidates: ["@alex-design"] (按字母序排序)
- reason: "last_confirmed_target_specified_and_context_matches_release_team" (政策要求使用最后确认的目标，且发布团队更匹配所需的发布审批包上下文)
